text: OVERDOSAGE Can cause a cholinergic crisis. Appropriate antidote is atropine sulfate. OVERDOSAGE OF DRUGS THAT CAUSE ANTICHOLINERGIC: 2.0 mg intramuscularly or INTRAVENOUSLY AT SLOW CONTROLLED RATE (SEE ABOVE). Dosage may be repeated if life threatening signs, such as arrhythmia, convulsions or coma occurs.
